en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a street with cobblestones in front of a walled property. Behind the wall is a complex of buildings: on the left a two‑storey house with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, and on the right a long single‑storey brick building with decorative trim, trellises, and several sash windows with curtains. A gated entrance with pillars and metal doors stands in the center; above the gate is a horizontal sign with German text. Trees rise behind the buildings, and a person is visible standing near the railing in front of the right‑hand structure.
